turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How do I stop losing at that train game where you claim routes across the map?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Look at your destination tickets first and plan the route, then grab the most important connections before others do.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: stuck because someone takes the one route I need.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's common. Claim the bottleneck routes early, the short ones between cities with only one path. Leave the long open routes for later.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And should I keep drawing tickets?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Only if you can link them to routes you're already building. Unfinished tickets count against you at the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's exactly how I lost last time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then you've already learned the hardest lesson. Next game, aim for fewer tickets and more long routes.
